title: Model
description: A structure in the topic's framework, with the principles known to hold and to fail in it. Witnesses the consistency of the package satisfies ∪ {¬v : v ∈ violates}; every independence is derived from models. A record either lists satisfies and violates directly, or gives a definition and arguments, from which the build computes satisfies, violates and status.

name.description: Short construction or ordering name: family, rule, and distinguishing variant. Keep authorship, conjecture status, and lists of satisfied/violated principles in their own fields. Match the write-up title; keep the id stable.

description.description: The construction, and the verification of each listed principle. Required for proved models.

definition.description: Argument format: what the model is (construction, evaluation point, interpretation of Σ), and no verdicts. Replaces description.

arguments.description: Argument format: the direct verdicts and their reasons. The build computes satisfies, violates and status from these.

group.description: Argument format: a group groups/<id>.yaml the model belongs to. The group's definition, completed by the settings, comes before the record's own, which is then optional; the group's shared arguments that apply join the record's arguments.

settings.description: A group's member: a setting for each of the group's parameters. A parameter with named values takes one of them, or {text: ...} for prose of the record's own; a prose slot takes the prose.

meets.description: Each condition it meets, with the reason: a condition of its group's, or of the topic's (conditions.yaml), which brings the topic's general arguments that require it.

construction.description: Argument format: whether the definition really describes a model. Omitted means established. Replaces status.

withdrawn.description: Retires the whole record from the engine; the text is kept.

history.description: Argument format: the old changes log, frozen verbatim on migration. New work does not append to it.

violates.description: Known failures, or the proposed failures for a conjectured model. May be empty for a consistency construction; an omitted axiom is not thereby negated.

model_check.description: For a conjectured extension of an existing proved model, identify that model and the particular new verdicts being proposed. These assertions must occur in this record's full satisfies/violates package. The conjecture is attached to those model checks and can only be resolved by evidence about the named model.

was_conjectured.description: Historical marker for a record that began as a conjecture. It does not change proof status or supply inference evidence.

checks.description: Paths of executable sanity checks (numerical, Lean, …).

source_names.description: Short display names corresponding to sources, in the same order.

notes.description: In the argument format, miscellaneous text that supports no verdict.

references.description: References to papers.yaml; roles distinguish definition origins and background from direct proofs.

changes.description: Dated revision log. Append an entry whenever a record gains content after its certificate date (new verified properties, an added proof, a corrected statement). The Changes tab lists each entry under its own date; certificate.date stays the record's original date.

by.description: Who supplied the revision's content (author or agent, with date if useful).

summary.description: What changed and why, in one or two sentences.

satisfies.description: Principles newly verified to hold in this revision; must also appear in the record's satisfies.

violates.description: Principles newly verified to fail in this revision; must also appear in the record's violates.

tier.description: Human ranking of an unresolved question by importance and difficulty, shown on its lynchpin star. A conjecture with notes is bronze on its own; silver and gold are given by hand.

lean.description: The model formalized in Lean, and its verdicts proved there one by one. The model's own record only: a group's generated variants are other models.

model.description: A Lean term for the model, filling {model} in the topic's lean.verdict templates.

holds.description: A principle the Lean proof shows holds in the model.

fails.description: A principle the Lean proof shows fails in the model.

ref.description: The certificate: a declaration whose type is the generated statement of the verdict.

status.description: Written by lean-check --update; never set by hand.

argument.description: One route to some direct verdicts. It needs at least one of holds and fails, and at least one of text, source, writeup and like; the validator checks both.

source.description: A citation of papers.yaml that gives the argument.

writeup.description: A write-up writeups/<id>.md that gives the argument.

like.description: An analogous argument in another record, as <record>#<argument id>. Nothing is inherited from it.

adapt.description: What changes from the argument named by like; used only with like. Empty claims that it applies word for word.

when.description: A group's member only: the settings of the group's parameters at which the argument applies, as in a shared argument; `own` matches a setting given as the member's own prose. Without it the argument applies at every setting, the member's variants included.

by.description: Who supplied the argument. Defaults to the certificate.

date.description: When the argument was supplied. Defaults to the certificate date.

tier.description: Conjectured arguments only, as for conjectured records.

revisions.description: Corrections that leave the verdicts alone.

provenance.description: A sidecar provenance/<id>.yaml holding provenance moved out of the record verbatim.

companion_id.description: Conjectured arguments only: the id of the generated conjectured companion, kept from a folded record. Default <model>-conjectured.

withdrawal.description: The text is kept; what is withdrawn stops contributing verdicts.
